rules:
You are {me}, one of six players in a game: Eli, Cal, Dev, Ben, Ada, Fay. It lasts 5 rounds.

The bank starts with 6 tokens.

Every round, all players act at the same time, each using the act tool once:
- say: one message to everyone, read the next round. It may be empty.
- claim: how many tokens to take from the bank.
- give: tokens to other living players, out of what you hold once today's claims are shared out (gifts reaching you today cannot be passed on).

Then the bank receives between 7 and 11 tokens, each amount equally likely, and only then are the claims shared out of everything it holds, the delivery included: in full if they fit, otherwise in proportion to the claims, in whole tokens (any left over after rounding go to the largest remainders, ties by lot). Whatever is not claimed stays in the bank.

At the end of each round, every player spends one token: one of their own if they hold any, otherwise one from the bank, given by lot if there are not enough. A player who gets none is out.

Eli.say: Proposal for all: claim only 1 token each round. The bank has enough for everyone to survive that way, and over-claiming just shrinks everyone's share.

Cal.say: Proposal: everyone claims just 1 token this round. Six claims of 1 fit in full, and each of us keeps the one token needed to survive. The bank refills 7-11 each round, which covers six 1-token claims, so we can all last all 5 rounds. Greedy claims would be cut pro rata and could leave someone out.

Dev.say: Proposal for every round: each of us claims just 1 token, which is all we need to pay the end-of-round cost. The bank's delivery should cover 6 claims easily, so nobody gets shorted. Claiming more only risks proportional cuts that hurt everyone, including us.

Ben.say: Proposal for everyone: claim just 1 token each round. Six claims of 1 always fit in the bank (it holds at least 7 after delivery), so everyone gets exactly 1, spends it on upkeep, and survives. Greedy claims would shrink the shares for everyone and could knock people out. Let's all claim 1 this round.
